subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should Browserbase session lifecycle be handled as a first-party browser profile driver now, routed through a generic browser-backend plugin seam, or reduced to docs that no longer recommend the static URL path?
rationale: The fix crosses commercial-service integration, browser-control security, credential storage, signed URL redaction, config/schema surface, and session lifecycle policy, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Revise Browserbase Driver Path
options.body: Accept a first-party Browserbase driver only after route coverage, credential contract, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

options.title: Design Generic Backend Seam First
options.body: Keep this issue tied to a browser backend/plugin API so Browserbase can ship outside core once the registration contract exists.

options.title: Document Current Limitation
options.body: Remove or narrow the static Browserbase docs until maintainers are ready to support the Sessions API lifecycle in product code.

recommendation.title: Revise Browserbase Driver Path
recommendation.body: Accept a first-party Browserbase driver only after route coverage, credential contract, signed URL redaction, cleanup semantics, and live OpenClaw proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main ownership signal across the browser plugin boundary and docs/runtime rewrite touched by this decision.
